set.body:
No fixture in this repo reaches PlacementBasis.Ambiguous. m1 established this by MEASURING the
four induction fixtures (33 details): the branch never fires, and real placement distributions
are concentrated -- [0.08 0.12 0.80], [0.11 0.89] -- nowhere near the even split the Ambiguous
branch would need. Full correction on bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY.

Ambiguous is the case where a recall unit is genuinely continuous with BOTH the digression and
the target -- a person's account that could honestly go either way. It is the case where an
honest placement summary matters most, and we have no evidence of what the code does there.

TASK: build an interview induction fixture that REACHES Ambiguous, and record what the code
actually does when it gets there. Not a fix -- an observation with evidence. The deliverable is
a fixture plus a test that documents current behaviour, whether that behaviour turns out to be
right or wrong.

WHY YOU AND NOT m1: m1 found this by retracting its own escalation, and the person who predicts
what a branch does is not the ideal person to build the fixture that tests it. Independence is
cheap here and worth having.

CONSTRAINTS. Do not change thresholds or the placement arithmetic -- this bead is measurement
only, and any change is argued against what the fixture SHOWS, not against the branch text.
Coordinate with m1, who owns bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY and whose P1 this unblocks. Reserve
your paths before editing. The fixture must be able to tell the hypotheses apart: if it cannot
distinguish genuine two-way continuity from a near-miss that routes elsewhere, it has not
reached Ambiguous and should not claim to.
set.title: interview: no fixture reaches PlacementBasis.Ambiguous - build one and record what the code does there
